tagline: Senior Quality Engineer, Web Application Developer, Sheppard of Agents
bio:
As a Senior Quality Engineer at REDspace Inc., I have spent over 15 years embedded within the Viacom, CBS, and Paramount+ ecosystem, helping build and validate the systems that power modern streaming.

My current focus is backend quality engineering, where I support functional and automated testing for enterprise video orchestration and packaging services. Leveraging custom Java/TestNG frameworks, I validate complex API behaviors to ensure the reliability of massive, high-visibility content delivery pipelines.

Over my tenure, my role has continuously evolved alongside the media landscape, backed by technical experience in web development and complex analytics integration for major brands like Comedy Central and Nickelodeon. I thrive on adaptability, deep technical problem-solving, and ensuring the seamless delivery of world-class digital experiences.

options.markdown:
Corey is a Halifax‑based technologist with four decades of hands‑on computing experience, and has been tinkering with computers since the days when programs loaded from cassette tapes and every pixel felt like magic. 

That early curiosity carried him through the C64, MS‑DOS, Windows, the rise of the web, and into a career spent building and improving digital experiences. His path blends technical depth with a socio-technical perspective, shaped by studies in **Sociology & Anthropology**, and science, technology & society at Mount Allison University.

After completing an honors diploma in **Applied Information Technology**, Corey moved into teaching and then into front‑end development, contributing to early e‑learning platforms at Click2Learn and later at LogicBay, to work on a wide range of digital products. Since 2008, he has been part of REDspace, working across front‑end development, analytics, and quality engineering.
